name: US Monthly Steel Output
citation: U.S. Federal Reserve Board of Governors. "Industrial Production: Manufacturing: Iron and Steel Products (IPN3311A2RS)." FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/IPN3311A2RS. Accessed 15 July 2026.

description:
Monthly seasonally-adjusted U.S. raw-steel (iron & steel products) industrial-production index (Federal Reserve G.17, NAICS 3311/3312), with manufacturing-sector and construction-demand covariates. Application: blast-furnace/EAF campaign planning and order-book commitment (capacity-utilization, furnace idling, scrap-vs-ore procurement).

Covariate glossary:
- raw steel industrial production index: Fed G.17 industrial-production index for iron & steel products, seasonally adjusted, 2017=100.
- manufacturing employment: all-employees, manufacturing sector, thousands of persons (FRED MANEMP).
- total construction spending: total U.S. construction put in place, millions of USD, seasonally-adjusted annual rate (FRED TTLCONS) - downstream steel demand.
- housing starts: new privately-owned housing units started, thousands of units, seasonally-adjusted annual rate (FRED HOUST) - downstream steel demand.
preprocessing: 1. Downloaded each monthly series from the FRED CSV endpoint (fredgraph.csv?id=<ID>).
2. Aligned target and covariates onto a common month-start (MS) time index.
3. Restricted to the common native span (first month where every covariate is observed through the last observed target month).
4. Forward-filled only sparse internal covariate gaps; no target imputation.
5. Dropped all calendar/timestep columns; kept a single shared ISO-8601 UTC timestamp index.
